lines.zh: 我摆着小尾，追不上母亲的影子。
lines.en: I wag my small tail and cannot catch my mother's shadow.

lines.zh: 暖水里我太小，一涡就转三圈。
lines.en: I am tiny in warm water; one eddy spins me three times.

lines.zh: 我学着成鱼的样子游，摇得很笨。
lines.en: I swim the way adults do, and wobble clumsily.

lines.zh: 鳍还软，我只能贴着沙走。
lines.en: My fins are still soft, so I skim the sand.

lines.zh: 我穿过热泉的泡，觉得好玩。
lines.en: I swim through vent bubbles for fun.

lines.zh: 我游两步就停，怕离洞太远。
lines.en: I swim two strokes and stop, afraid of straying.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我还小，落在石头上。
lines.en: My shadow, smaller than me, falls on the stone.

lines.zh: 我跟在一群小鱼后面，认错了妈。
lines.en: I trail a school of small fish, mistaking one for mother.

lines.zh: 水流一推，我就飘出半米。
lines.en: One push of current carries me half a meter.

lines.zh: 我钻过珊瑚缝，鳞被蹭掉一点。
lines.en: I squeeze through a coral gap and scrape off scales.

lines.zh: 我绕着热泉画圈，练自己的尾。
lines.en: I circle the vent, practising with my tail.

lines.zh: 深海里我只是一小口，可我还在游。
lines.en: In the deep I am one small mouthful, but I keep swimming.

lines.zh: 我贴着大人的腹侧，跟着它的水。
lines.en: I press to an adult's flank and ride its wake.

lines.zh: 我扭来扭去，练怎么不撞到石。
lines.en: I twist about, learning not to hit the rocks.

lines.zh: 我撞上气泡，翻了个身
lines.en: I hit a bubble and tumble over.

lines.zh: 尾鳍太小，我摆得很快
lines.en: My tail fin is small, so I beat it fast.

lines.zh: 我悬在暖水中间，鳍不停地抖。
lines.en: I hang in the warm water with fins quivering.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，只露出一只眼。
lines.en: I hide in a crevice with one eye showing.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等碎食自己飘来。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open for scraps to drift in.

lines.zh: 我太小，浪一大就要抓石头。
lines.en: I am so small that any surge makes me grab stone.

lines.zh: 我靠着热泉，那里比别处暖。
lines.en: I stay by the vent, warmer than anywhere else.

lines.zh: 我吐个泡，看它摇摇晃晃升上去。
lines.en: I puff a bubble and watch it wobble upward.

lines.zh: 我缩着身子，尽量不像猎物。
lines.en: I tuck in, trying not to look like prey.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的心跳，快得厉害。
lines.en: I count my heartbeat; it races.

lines.zh: 我贴住母亲留下的痕迹，不动。
lines.en: I press to the trace my mother left and keep still.

lines.zh: 我打了个小转，又回到原处。
lines.en: I make a small turn and come back to the same spot.

lines.zh: 黑水里我什么都看不清，只能听。
lines.en: I see nothing in the black water, so I listen.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，让鳃慢慢换水。
lines.en: I stay still and let my gills change the water.

lines.zh: 我累了，就靠在一颗热石上。
lines.en: When tired, I lean on a warm stone.

lines.zh: 我还不会浮，只能一直游。
lines.en: I cannot hover yet, so I must keep swimming.

lines.zh: 你潜下来，我吓得贴在石头上。
lines.en: You dive down and I flatten against the stone.

lines.zh: 我仰头看你，你比热泉还大。
lines.en: I look up; you are bigger than the vent.

lines.zh: 你的手一动，我退到石缝里。
lines.en: Your hand moves and I back into the crevice.

lines.zh: 我从水草后看你，尾巴在抖。
lines.en: I watch you from the weeds, tail trembling.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我不知该游还是该躲。
lines.en: When you look at me I cannot decide whether to swim or hide.

lines.zh: 你灯一晃，我以为来了大鱼。
lines.en: Your light swings and I think a big fish has come.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，又躲回去。
lines.en: I circle you halfway, then retreat again.

lines.zh: 你的面罩反光，我当成亮石头。
lines.en: Your mask glints and I take it for bright stone.

lines.zh: 我试着靠近一点，马上又退。
lines.en: I try to come closer, then immediately back off.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，那东西太大了。
lines.en: I stare at your boots; they are far too big.

lines.zh: 你伤到我，我疼得直打转。
lines.en: You hurt me and I spin from the pain.

lines.zh: 我的鳞翻起来，露出粉白的肉。
lines.en: My scales peel up, showing pinkish white flesh.

lines.zh: 我太小，这一下就够我躺很久。
lines.en: I am so small that one blow leaves me down a long time.

lines.zh: 我逃进石缝，血丝跟着飘。
lines.en: I flee into the crevice with threads of blood trailing.

lines.zh: 伤口的疼让我忘了往哪游。
lines.en: The pain makes me forget which way to swim.

lines.zh: 我听见自己吱了一声，很细。
lines.en: I hear myself squeak, very thin.

lines.zh: 我撞着石头跑，越跑越慌。
lines.en: I bolt into stones, panicking more with each hit.

lines.zh: 母亲的影子不在，我只能自己躲。
lines.en: Mother's shadow is absent; I must hide alone.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，等你走远再出来。
lines.en: I hide in the crevice until you walk away.

lines.zh: 我的尾还在摆，可已经没力气。
lines.en: My tail still moves, but I have no strength left.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎肉屑，我不敢先吃。
lines.en: The meat scraps you scatter, I dare not eat first.

lines.zh: 甜味太浓，我围着它转了三圈。
lines.en: The sweetness is strong; I circle it three times.

lines.zh: 母亲没教过我这个，可我饿了。
lines.en: Mother never taught me this, but I am hungry.

lines.zh: 你把糖放在石上，我才敢过去。
lines.en: You set the candy on stone and only then do I approach.

lines.zh: 我闻着想尝，又怕肚子撑坏。
lines.en: I sniff and want a taste, afraid of overfilling.

lines.zh: 我咬了一小口，甜得直摆尾。
lines.en: I nibble once and the sweetness sets my tail wagging.

lines.zh: 你手别动，我过来了。
lines.en: Keep your hand still; I am coming over.

lines.zh: 我太小，一颗糖够我吃一天。
lines.en: I am so small that one candy lasts a day.

lines.zh: 我蹭着你的手指，想再要一点。
lines.en: I rub your finger, hoping for a little more.

lines.zh: 这点甜要是吃多了，会不会胀破。
lines.en: Too much of this sweetness might burst me.

lines.zh: 你碰我一下，我翻了个跟头。
lines.en: One touch from you flips me head over tail.

lines.zh: 我被水流推开，撞在你腿上。
lines.en: The current shoves me and I bump your leg.

lines.zh: 我太小，你的脚像一堵墙。
lines.en: I am so small that your foot is a wall.

lines.zh: 你挤过来，我钻到了石头下面。
lines.en: You press in and I duck under a stone.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的护目镜，眼冒金星。
lines.en: I bump your goggles and see stars.

lines.zh: 被顶开时，我只能乱摆尾巴。
lines.en: Shoved aside, all I can do is flail my tail.

lines.zh: 我贴在你靴边，像片小叶子。
lines.en: I cling to your boot like a tiny leaf.

lines.zh: 你一转身，水把我甩出去。
lines.en: You turn and the water flings me away.

lines.zh: 我撞到同伴，我们一起打了个转。
lines.en: I bump a sibling and we spin together.

lines.zh: 被挤得紧了，我会吱一声。
lines.en: Squeezed tight, I let out a squeak.

lines.zh: 我还小，只会跟同伴挤在一起。
lines.en: I am still young; I only huddle with my siblings.

lines.zh: 我们几条小苗追着尾巴玩。
lines.en: We fry chase each other's tails for fun.

lines.zh: 它用吻碰我，我们都不懂。
lines.en: It touches my snout and neither of us understands.

lines.zh: 我们并排悬着，像一串小泡泡。
lines.en: We hang side by side like a string of small bubbles.

lines.zh: 等长大，我们才各自找伴。
lines.en: Only when grown will we each seek a mate.

lines.zh: 我跟着它游，转头就忘了它。
lines.en: I follow it, then forget it the moment I turn.

lines.zh: 我们挨着睡在石缝，谁都不动。
lines.en: We sleep pressed together in a crevice, none moving.

lines.zh: 它抢我的碎食，我没生气。
lines.en: It steals my scraps and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我学着成鱼蹭来蹭去，觉得奇怪。
lines.en: I copy the adults' rubbing and find it strange.

lines.zh: 我们挤在暖水里，比一个人好。
lines.en: We crowd in the warm water, better than being alone.

lines.zh: 我叼不住，碎食总从嘴边漏。
lines.en: I cannot hold it; scraps keep leaking from my mouth.

lines.zh: 有东西沉下来，我先咬一口试试。
lines.en: Something sinks down and I test it with one bite.

lines.zh: 我用小鳍拨它，它比我重。
lines.en: I nudge it with a fin; it is heavier than me.

lines.zh: 我吞了一块，肚子鼓得像球。
lines.en: I swallow a piece and my belly rounds like a ball.

lines.zh: 捡不起来，我只好把嘴凑上去。
lines.en: I cannot lift it, so I bring my mouth to it.

lines.zh: 它卡在石缝里，我啃了半天。
lines.en: It is stuck in a crevice and I gnaw for ages.

lines.zh: 我连沙一起吞了，味道不好。
lines.en: I swallow sand with it, which tastes awful.

lines.zh: 你丢下的碎屑，被我抢走一半。
lines.en: Half the crumbs you drop, I snatch away.

lines.zh: 我含着食物游，怕别人来抢。
lines.en: I swim with food in my mouth, afraid of robbers.

lines.zh: 我把吃的压在石头下，回头再找。
lines.en: I pin food under a stone and come back for it later.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近石缝，我把鳍收起来。
lines.en: Something nears the crevice and I pull my fins in.

lines.zh: 我只敢盯比自己小的。
lines.en: I only dare to eye things smaller than me.

lines.zh: 一只小虾游过，我跟了上去。
lines.en: A small shrimp swims past and I follow.

lines.zh: 它的影子罩下来，我知道要跑。
lines.en: Its shadow falls over me and I know to run.

lines.zh: 我第一次想追，追得很笨。
lines.en: My first attempt at chasing is very clumsy.

lines.zh: 我鼓起腮，装成比实际大。
lines.en: I puff my cheeks to look bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 母亲在远处，我看向它。
lines.en: Mother is far off, and I look toward her.

lines.zh: 有动静，我先把身子缩紧。
lines.en: At any noise I first tighten my body.

lines.zh: 我盯着那点碎肉，看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at that scrap of meat for a long while.

lines.zh: 我试着冲过去，水流把我推歪了。
lines.en: I try to dash over and the current pushes me off course.

lines.zh: 我悬着，让鳞贴紧身子。
lines.en: I hover with my scales pressed close.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的须，那是它先动的地方。
lines.en: I watch its antennae; that is what moves first.

lines.zh: 我绕着石头转，不敢正面撞。
lines.en: I circle the stone, not daring a frontal hit.

lines.zh: 我张开小嘴，牙齿还没长齐。
lines.en: I open my small mouth, teeth not yet all in.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就往后缩半寸。
lines.en: It moves and I shrink back half an inch.

lines.zh: 我摆尾试探，看它退不退。
lines.en: I flick my tail to test whether it backs off.

lines.zh: 我盯着不放，虽然打不过。
lines.en: I keep staring, though I cannot win.

lines.zh: 我把身子横过来，装得更宽。
lines.en: I turn broadside to look wider.

lines.zh: 我贴着热泉等，这里是我熟的地。
lines.en: I wait by the vent, ground I know.

lines.zh: 它靠近，我的心跳快得像鼓。
lines.en: It comes closer and my heart beats like a drum.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，它几乎没感觉到。
lines.en: I ram it and it barely notices.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的须，被甩了一圈。
lines.en: I bite its antenna and get swung in a circle.

lines.zh: 我用头顶，顶在自己石头上。
lines.en: I butt with my head and hit my own stone.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，可我不肯松口。
lines.en: The blow is light, but I will not let go.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，被水推开了。
lines.en: I lunge and the water pushes me away.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，嘴里全是沙。
lines.en: I bite once and my mouth fills with sand.

lines.zh: 我学着成鱼压过去，压不住。
lines.en: I press down as adults do, and cannot.

lines.zh: 它退了一步，我竟然赢了。
lines.en: It steps back, and somehow I have won.

lines.zh: 我撞得太狠，自己翻进沙里。
lines.en: I hit too hard and flip into the sand.

lines.zh: 我咬完就逃，躲回石缝。
lines.en: I bite and flee back into the crevice.

lines.zh: 我从刷怪蛋里出来，比指头还小。
lines.en: I come out of the spawn egg, smaller than a finger.

lines.zh: 暖水一裹，我马上开始摆尾。
lines.en: Warm water wraps me and I start beating my tail.

lines.zh: 我以前是卵，现在要自己找食。
lines.en: I was an egg before; now I must find food myself.

lines.zh: 第一口我呛了水，咳出一个泡。
lines.en: My first gulp chokes me and I cough a bubble.

lines.zh: 我张望四周，都是比我大的鱼。
lines.en: I look around; every fish is bigger than me.

lines.zh: 我落地就找石缝，那里安全。
lines.en: I land and look for a crevice, which is safe.

lines.zh: 我生来就胖，但还没有那层厚脂。
lines.en: I am born plump, but without the thick blubber yet.

lines.zh: 我游不稳，绕着热泉打转。
lines.en: I swim unsteadily, circling the hot vent.

lines.zh: 深海黑得早，我靠热泉认家。
lines.en: The deep grows dark early; I know home by the vent.

lines.zh: 我第一次呼吸，鳃张得很开。
lines.en: My first breath opens my gills wide.

lines.zh: 火离我很远，热气还是烫坏了鳍。
lines.en: The fire is far off, yet the heat still scalds my fins.

lines.zh: 我被冲出水面，落回时摔在石上。
lines.en: I am flung from the water and land on stone.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里呼吸，这会儿鳃却堵了。
lines.en: I should breathe here, yet my gills are blocked.

lines.zh: 炸开的水把我推到岩壁上。
lines.en: The blast shoves the water and me into the wall.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的鳞，留下一条白痕。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my scales and leaves a white line.

lines.zh: 魔法的光让我整条鱼都僵住。
lines.en: Magic light freezes my whole body.

lines.zh: 我饿得贴住石头，连摆尾都省了。
lines.en: Hunger pins me to the stone; I even save my tail.

lines.zh: 电顺着水过来，我的鳍全麻了。
lines.en: Current comes through the water and numbs all my fins.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我的鳃一下下空张。
lines.en: No water in the void; my gills open on nothing.
